tools.name: rainbow_search_charters
tools.description: Charter flight destinations sold by Rainbow Tours (biletyczarterowe.r.pl) matching optional destination/origin/date filters: per destination you get the country, region, nearest departure date, baggage allowance and the lowest per-person price. Prices are charter seat prices in PLN. Use rainbow_sear

tools.name: rainbow_search_outbound
tools.description: Day-by-day outbound charter flights to ONE Rainbow destination in a date window: per day the cheapest price and every flight with origin, departure time, airline, flight number, baggage and per-person/total price. Prices are charter seat prices in PLN. Get destination codes from rainbow_search_chart

tools.name: itaka_search_charters
tools.description: Charter flight itineraries from Itaka.pl between a Polish origin and a charter destination: each itinerary carries full legs (airports, dates, times, carrier, stops), per-person and total price, and a direct booking URL. Prices are charter seat prices in PLN. Only supports Itaka's fixed airport list

tools.name: tui_search_charters
tools.description: Charter destinations sold on TUI.pl for a stay-length window, with per-person and total prices: filter by origin/destination airports and trip duration in days. Prices are charter seat prices in PLN. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, passengers, duration, count, destinations: [..
